extracted.intended_audience: investigators applying for an NIH NIAID K08 Mentored Clinical Scientist Research Career Development Award (applicants, mentors, research administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation of a mentored clinical scientist (K08) career development grant application to NIAID/NIH, covering candidate career development, specific aims, research strategy, human subjects protections, institutional resources, mentoring, budgets, and required NIH plans (resource sharing, authentication, inclusion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary/Abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Summary/Abstract  This proposal presents a five year research career development program focused on the study of antibody mediated immune modulation in tuberculosis to expand the breadth and depth of understanding the role of humoral immunity in this disease.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise description of the proposed work and career development plan: state the program length, overall objective, importance/significance, cross-disciplinary approach, candidate status, and the specific aims (the sample lists Aims 1–3). Should make clear how the research and training will position the candidate for independence and the public-health relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Narrative / Public Health Relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Narrative  One third of the world’s population carries the burden of tuberculosis. ... The proposed research will explore the role of humoral immunity in tuberculosis disease with the vision that antibody features may be harnessed to expand the repertoire for immune correlates, diagnostics and rational vaccine design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the public health relevance and translational significance in plain language for a general audience; justify why the research matters to public health.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: The specific aims of this proposal are 1: Define the antigen specificity of functional M. tuberculosis (Mtb) specific antibodies, 2: Dissect the role for Fc/FcR mediated intracellular Mtb restriction and 3: Identify the macrophage effector mechanisms through which Ab restrict intracellular Mtb.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly state a limited set of focused, testable aims. Each aim should be described succinctly and tied to the overall objective and career-development vision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy (Significance, Innovation, Approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: The scientific objective of this proposal is to begin to define the Ab Fab and Fc features with the capacity to mediate effector function against intracellular Mtb with the vision of targeted transition into an appropriate animal model to generate hypotheses that inform the direction and design of subsequent human studies to expand the repertoire for immune correlates/diagnostics and rational vaccine design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide background and preliminary data, articulate significance and innovation, and describe detailed experimental approach and rationale (including plans to transition to animal models where appropriate). Describe methods, expected outcomes, contingencies, and how results will inform next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development
rubrics_metrics.description: The outlined proposal builds on the candidate’s previous research and clinical experience ... The proposed experiments and didactic work will position the candidate with a unique set of cross disciplinary skills that will enable her transition to independence as a physician scientist ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the candidate's past experience, specific career-development goals, planned didactic and mentored activities, timeline for training, and how these activities will enable transition to independence. Show how the research fits with career goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentors, Advisory Committee, and Letters of Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Senior/Key Personnel: Lenette Lu PD/PI; SARAH FORTUNE M.D. Other Professional-Mentor; GALIT ALTER Other Professional-Co-Mentor; [plus advisory committee and collaborators listed].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List mentor(s), co-mentors, collaborators, and advisory committee members with roles and institutional affiliations. Include mentor statements/plans, letters of support, description of mentoring interactions, and evidence of mentor track record and commitment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources / Institutional Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ragon facilities include the flow cytometry core, the microscopy core, a Biacore, and a BSL3 facility with the capacity for flow cytometry and sorting as well as live cell imaging. ... The Boston TB research community is well nucleated ... Harvard Catalyst provides rich resources ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe institutional resources, cores, equipment, biosafety facilities, collaborative environment, seminars, courses, and support services that will enable the research and training. Explain how the institutional environment and community will support the candidate's transition to independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development (section present in TOC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide explicit institutional commitment letters and statements that describe protected time, resources, and support for the candidate's career development and research program during the award period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Subjects Research  Only coded specimens collected from subjects who have consented to participate in existing IRB approved protocols will be used. ... Protocol #: 2014P000437/MGH: Secondary Use of Plasma Specimens ... Expedited Review 3/12/2014. Action: Not Human Research. ... 1. Risks to the subjects ... 2. Adequacy of protection against risk ... 3. Potential benefits ... 4. Importance of the knowledge to be gained ... Targeted/Planned Enrollment Table: No subjects will be specifically recruited or enrolled for this project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full human-subjects protection plan: describe involvement and characteristics, consent processes, IRB approvals/assurances, whether specimens are coded and who has access to identifiers, potential risks, monitoring/mitigation strategies, confidentiality measures, potential benefits, importance of knowledge, enrollment reporting, and data-safety monitoring plan appropriate to study category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects Risk Specifics and Mitigation (procedural risks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Potential risks: For standard blood draws, phlebotomy may cause a small amount of pain or bruising ... Repeated blood donation can lead to anemia ... leukapheresis: adverse reactions to the anticoagulant (Acid Citrate Dextrose Type A) ... anticoagulant binds to calcium ... donors are sometimes given a calcium supplement during the donation to prevent this reaction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify procedure-specific risks (phlebotomy, leukapheresis), describe monitoring and clinical safeguards, blood-draw limits and laboratory monitoring, and plans for clinical follow-up and care for adverse events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recruitment and Informed Consent
rubrics_metrics.description: Recruitment and informed consent: Potential participants may also contact the study team directly in response to flyers, Internet postings, and advertisements. Written informed consent will be obtained only after a potential subject has had an opportunity to read the consent, discuss study participation with a study team member, and ask questions. No study-related activity will take place prior to obtaining written informed consent. All informed consent documents have been reviewed and approved by the UT-H - SPH - Brownsville Regional Camp/RAHC and Partners IRB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe recruitment methods, informed consent procedures, timing, who obtains consent, IRB review of consent documents, and ensure no activities occur prior to consent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality and Data Access Controls
rubrics_metrics.description: All specimens used for these studies will be coded ... The PI will not have access to either the PHI or the key to the code linking the identity of the subjects ... Data collected will be coded by research identification number. Each user has a unique username and password and level of access determined by assigned role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how identifiers are protected, coding procedures, access controls to data/specimens, secure databases, role-based access, and how PI will be prevented from accessing identifiers if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women and Minorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of women and minorities  Eligible adult males and females from all ethnic backgrounds are included in the cohorts utilized in this study.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State inclusion criteria for sex/gender and race/ethnicity and provide plans and rationale for inclusion or justified exclusions; report enrollment and analyses by sex and race/ethnicity where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of Children   The samples used in the studies described in this proposal will be obtained from cohorts of individuals with latent or active tuberculosis. Only samples from adults and children aged 18 and over will be obtained.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether children are included or excluded and justify; provide age ranges and any special protections when children are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Inclusion Enrollment Report / Demographics Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS Inclusion Enrollment Report ... Using an Existing Dataset or Resource: Yes ... Cumulative (Actual) enrollment table with racial and ethnic category breakdowns is provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide required PHS inclusion enrollment reporting with planned vs actual enrollment and breakdowns by sex/gender, race, and ethnicity (and indicate if using existing datasets/resources).

rubrics_metrics.name: Data and Safety Monitoring (Applicability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Data and Safety Monitoring for Clinical Trials: Not applicable (Category B: not a clinical trial).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify whether the project is a clinical trial and, if so, provide a data and safety monitoring plan proportional to risks; if not applicable, state category and justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan and NIH Public Access
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource Sharing Plan  I acknowledge the importance of timely release of scientific information and resources to the broader community. ... I plan to present the results generated by these studies at national and international conferences and publish the data in peer reviewed journals in a timely fashion. In addition, I am committed to the NIH Public Access policy. ... transfers of materials to academic and not-for-profit researchers for non-commercial research will be done in a timely fashion and at no cost, except for standard maintenance and transportation expenses, with terms as found in the institutional standard material transfer agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe plans for data, materials, and resource sharing (publications, repositories, MTAs), timelines, costs to requesters, and compliance with NIH public access and applicable data-sharing policies; explain inapplicability when relevant (e.g., no model organisms, no GWAS).

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources  Key biological resources in this proposal include 1: Sera from human individuals ... Key control experiments performed in Dr Alter’s lab have validated that the functional activity of IgG isolated via our methods of preparation and storage are maintained over time and freeze thaw cycles ... This is confirmed by endotoxin testing. 2: Primary human monocyte derived macrophages ... Monocyte derived macrophages were characterized by flow cytometry as CD14-, CD40+, HLA ABC+, CD11b+, CD16+ (FcγRIIIa) and CD32+ (FcγRIIa). ... 3. CEM-NKr CCR5+ T lymphoblast cell line ... maintained per suggested protocol by NIH AIDS reagents ... 4. Primary human natural killer (NK) cells ... purity of their isolation is confirmed by flow cytometry as CD3- and CD16 and/or CD56+.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify key biological/chemical resources, provide provenance and sourcing, describe validation and quality-control experiments (e.g., functional validation, endotoxin testing), characterize cells/lines by markers or assays, detail maintenance and monitoring procedures, donor screening steps, and include appropriate controls to validate assays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materials, Reagents and Cell Line Controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Internal controls to validate functionality include the lack of antibody and the absence of antigen to assess indiscriminate cellular cytotoxicity. Further validation of the Ab dependent cellular cytotoxicity assays lies within validation of natural killer (NK) cells as described below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the negative and positive controls for assays, how controls are used to validate assay performance, and periodic QC measures for reagents and cell lines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget and Budget Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtotal Direct Costs (excludes consortium F&A) Year 1: Year 2: Year 3: Year 4: Year 5: ... Research & Related Budget Year - 1 ... Budget Justification ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide itemized budget by year, justify direct costs and personnel, explain consortium and F&A treatment, and ensure consistency with scope of work and institutional policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Existing Datasets/Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Using an Existing Dataset or Resource: Yes (indicated in PHS Inclusion Enrollment Report and Other Project Information).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If using existing datasets or specimens, document their source, approvals for secondary use, coding/anonymization, and any limitations imposed by original consent or governance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research (listed in Table of Contents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include an RCR training plan that specifies format, subject matter, faculty involvement, frequency, and duration to satisfy NIH requirements for career development awards.
